info.title: Netgress Map API
info.description: Read-only Netgress API for third-party maps, reviewed 2026-10-26. Includes public agent profiles, owner-only keys and inventory summaries, and world MU balance. Allowed browser origins: https://intel.ingress.com, https://intel-x.ingress.com, https://pr0head.github.io. Bearer Intel tokens remain read-only and are required for every GET. Examples are synthetic.

post.summary: Sign in to an existing verified Netgress account
post.description: Requires an existing game profile. New read-only sessions do not expire automatically (expires_at null). Browser CORS is restricted.

get.summary: Read portals, links and fields in a viewport
get.description: Portals from zoom 15; strict minimum link-length thresholds at lower zoom. Fields have no minimum size threshold. Maximum 3000 portals / 2000 links / 2000 fields. No continuation cursor. See the guide for truncation and geodesic rendering.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: west,south,east,north in WGS84 degrees. Longitude [-180,180], latitude [-90,90], south <= north. west > east crosses the antimeridian.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag from a cached successful response for the same URL/account.

ETag.description: Content validator. Send as If-None-Match for the same URL/account.

Cache-Control.description: Successful Intel GET returns private, no-cache.

304.description: Unchanged representation; no body. Use cached JSON for the same URL/account.

ETag.description: Content validator. Send as If-None-Match for the same URL/account.

get.summary: Read the visible viewport activity log
get.description: Uses historical event anchor position and server faction visibility. Up to 50 events. Initial/older pages sort descending; after pages sort ascending. cursor and after are mutually exclusive and bound to account, faction, direction and exact bbox. distance_m is currently 0, not measured.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: west,south,east,north in WGS84 degrees. Longitude [-180,180], latitude [-90,90], south <= north. west > east crosses the antimeridian.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Older continuation from next; cannot be combined with after.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: New-event continuation; cannot be combined with cursor.

get.summary: Read the current token owner profile
get.description: Owner is derived exclusively from the Intel token. Same public fields as an agent profile; no email, location, XM, route or inventory. no-store.

Cache-Control.description: no-store; do not cache personal data.

get.summary: Read a public agent profile by UUID
get.description: Existing profiles only. Invalid/missing UUID returns 404. Medals and lifetime/current statistics preserve availability and coverage flags.

Cache-Control.description: no-store; do not cache personal data.

get.summary: Resolve an exact nickname and read a public profile

parameters.name: nickname
parameters.description: Exact nickname, case-insensitive. URL-encode Unicode and reserved characters. No wildcard/list search.

Cache-Control.description: no-store; do not cache personal data.

get.summary: Read a bounded page of owned portal keys
get.description: Maximum 128 portals. quantity = available_quantity + contained_quantity. Includes own loose keys and keys inside own capsules/MUFG; excludes drops and other owners. Each page is a fresh read; no cross-page snapshot. no-store.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Previous next_cursor; empty for the first page. Otherwise canonical lowercase UUID.

Cache-Control.description: no-store; do not cache personal data.

get.description: One aggregate per kind+level, sorted. quantity combines loose items and contents of all owned capsules/MUFG, without a container split. Containers themselves count under their own kind. No item/container IDs, names, operations or other users. level=0 for non-levelled kinds. no-store.

Cache-Control.description: no-store; do not cache personal data.

get.summary: Read the published world MU balance
get.description: Active-field faction balance in the active MU epoch, not lifetime personal MU. Uses background snapshot only. Partial/stale/empty snapshots do not invent percentages. Disabled/unavailable returns null counts. Green=enlightened, blue=resistance. A snapshot older than two minutes is stale.

304.description: Unchanged; no body. Reuse same URL/account cached response.

IntelBearer.description: Token issued by POST /v1/auth/intel/login. Read-only; not a game access token.

password.description: Maximum 256 UTF-8 bytes on server; do not retain the password.

token.description: Opaque read-only bearer secret with ngi_ prefix; not a JWT.

anyOf.description: New sessions currently return null: no scheduled expiry.

Link.description: Direction is defined by source_portal_id, never by vertices ordering.

mu.description: Confirmed MU; null means unavailable, not zero.

min_link_length_m.description: Strict length threshold in metres; zero means all links.

Truncated.description: Only exceeded collections need a key. Missing key means false.

MapSnapshot.description: One viewport snapshot. No map pagination; graph vertices may be absent from portals.

kind.description: Stable variant key, for example shield_common.

name.description: Server catalogue display name; use as text.

ModSpec.description: Current server catalogue values, not fixed Ingress balance.

distance_m.description: Currently 0 on Intel route, not a measured distance.

next.description: Older-page continuation. Empty when exhausted or querying after.

after.description: New-event continuation. Keep head after separate from historical pagination.

more.description: More events exist in the requested direction. For after, continue using after.

next_cursor.description: Empty string at end; otherwise the last portal UUID. Pages are not a pinned snapshot.

400.description: Invalid input, bbox, zoom or cursor.

401.description: Invalid login or missing/revoked Intel token.

403.description: Origin is not allowed by server CORS.

404.description: Agent or portal not found (agent_not_found / portal_not_found).

429.description: Rate limit or temporary request admission limit.

Retry-After.description: Delay in seconds; may differ across server limits.
